instruction: Using GIMP, open 'character.png' from the Desktop and resize it to exactly 300x300 pixels. Export the resized image as 'character_resized.png' to the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires resizing the character.png image to exactly 300x300 pixels using GIMP's Image > Scale Image feature. Evaluator verifies the output file has the correct dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all requirements: resize to 300x300 pixels and export as character_resized.png
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches the output file from /home/user/Desktop/character_resized.png
Metric (check_image_resize__eed0216b) correctly opens the image with PIL and checks actual dimensions against expected 300x300
Metric properly handles expected parameter - receives rules dict directly from get_rule and accesses width/height correctly
Expected values are semantically correct (width=300, height=300 matches instruction exactly)
Edge cases properly handled: None file returns 0.0, image open errors caught and return 0.0
Complete coverage: verifies both the file export (by fetching from correct path) and resize operation (by checking dimensions)
